# QnALog 1.5.1

QnALog improves continuation targeting, transcript recovery, and queue progress reporting.

## Changes

- Keep a continuation tied to the note selected when recording starts, even if an asynchronous active-note read completes later.
- Merge continuation transcript blocks from the validated transcript ledger, including notes without an outer transcript container; avoid duplicating blocks when resuming a partial write.
- Show queue work, note writing, failure, and retry as distinct progress states, and refresh the status as soon as a retry starts.

## User impact

- No settings schema, API key storage, provider configuration, or device-selection changes; no reconfiguration is required.
- Existing notes are not rewritten in bulk. A continuation updates only its saved target note.
- Previously saved failed continuation tasks retain their stored target. Review the task's target before manually retrying it; this release does not retarget old tasks automatically.
- No user-facing features were removed.
